newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down, no impact from Thai news.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down, no impact from Thai news.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices fell at the close as the market ended another day without buying interest, traders said.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS1 buyer at 291.50 cents ($1.16) a kg, down one cent from Monday. May SMR20 buyer ended half cent lower at 276.50.

Trading houses quoted SMR CV at 346 cents a kg, SMR L at 326, SMR 5 at 288, SMR 10 at 279, SMR 20 at 278 and drum latex FOB at 234 cents. Dealers at the houses said no inquiries or sales were recorded for the day.
